comments.author: Donce
comments.body: Lace gloves can be made for 510 Handicraft Points at Anita in Florence (5 fine dye, 10 Silk Cloth, 7 Lace)

comments.author: Sharky
comments.body: Saw a pair of these in Seville bazaar with: +1 alcohol, crafts, and spice trading for 100m.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: The recipe requires r14 handicrafts as well. These gloves have no skill boosts on them, but I think I remember the gloves Sharky mentioned were in the cove at one point?

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: The one that gives +1 to alcohol, crafts, and spice trading is from Treasure Cove. The one you can make in Florence with Anita gives no boost.
